newsitem.title: USA: North American Mortgage Dec loan fundings.
newsitem.headline: North American Mortgage Dec loan fundings.

text.p: North American Mortgage Co said its December 1996 loan fundings were $889 million, up three percent from December 1995 fundings of $862 million.
Loan fundings for the calendar year 1996 were $9.5 billion, up 26 percent from a year ago.

December 1996 loan applications were $1.17 billion, versus $1.25 billion in December 1995. Loan applications for year-to-date December 1996 were $16.0 billion, up 25 percent over year-to-date December 1995 applications.
Refinancings were 46 percent of fundings and 49 percent of applications for December 1996.
